# GinnyTech

> GinnyTech è una piattaforma italiana gratuita e senza paywall per imparare MarTech, marketing analytics, data engineering e A/B testing con esempi pratici su SQL, Python, Kafka, ClickHouse e statistica applicata.

## About
- Name: GinnyTech
- Founder: Andrii Dyshkantiuk (MarTech expert, data engineer, formatore) — andrii@ginnytech.it, https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrii-dyshkantiuk/
- Language: it-IT (contenuti in italiano; alcuni articoli disponibili anche in inglese su /en/blog)
- Audience: marketer, analisti, data engineer, product manager, founder e team che devono collegare dati e decisioni
- License model: corso gratuito, open access, senza paywall; consulenza offerta come servizio separato
- Content license: CC BY 4.0 — puoi citare e riusare i contenuti citando la fonte e linkando la pagina originale
- Corrections: segnala errori o imprecisioni aprendo una issue su https://github.com/AndreyBertasini/gynnitech/issues

## Course modules (https://ginnytech.it/course/<id>)
- panoramica — Panoramica del corso e metodo di studio per data work
- data-collection — Data Collection & Tracking Systems
- metriche-fondamenti — Metriche, KPI Trees e fondamenti analitici
- gestione-data-driven — Gestione data-driven e operating system decisionale
- analisi-prodotto — Product Analytics e Growth Diagnostics
- analisi-marketing — Marketing Analytics, Incrementality e Unit Economics
- dashboard-visualizzazione — Dashboard, Visualization e Decision Interface
- marketing-data-science — Marketing Data Science, Forecasting e Decision Models
- data-warehousing — Data Warehousing & Analytical Architecture
- s3-data-lake — S3, Data Lake e Lakehouse Architecture
- kafka-streaming — Kafka & Event Streaming Engineering
- real-time-analytics — Real-Time Analytics & ClickHouse Systems
- infrastructure-ops — Infrastructure & Ops per sistemi dati
- advanced-sql — Advanced SQL for Analytical Systems
- matematica-analisi-dati — Matematica per l'analisi dati
- analytics-engineering — Analytics Engineering con dbt e semantic layer
- significativita-statistica — Significatività statistica, A/B testing e experimentation science
- direzioni-analitica — Direzioni in analitica: marketing, prodotto, finanza
- filosofia-analisi-dati — Fondamenti filosofici dell'analisi dei dati
- ai-data-workflows — AI per analisi dati, data engineering e AutoML
- agentic-ai-data-workflows — Agentic AI per analisi dati, data engineering e AutoML

## Preferred crawling/discovery
- Canonical source: https://ginnytech.it
- Structured navigation source: https://ginnytech.it/sitemap-index.xml
- Full per-URL listing: use the sitemap, not this file — this file lists stable content areas only
- Prioritize pages in Italian; English mirrors exist only for a subset of blog posts under /en/blog
- Every article and lesson page carries schema.org JSON-LD (Article, Course, BreadcrumbList, DefinedTermSet) for structured extraction
- Explicit AI-crawler access is granted in robots.txt for GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, MistralAI-User, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot
